title: Ztockz Source Graph v1
description: One machine-readable decision map: for each of the 92 canonical columns and each screen-only field it names the primary source, the ordered fallbacks, the independent cross-checks, the methodology and the access constraints. The graph stores no market value and no credential.
conflict_policy: do not average; primary wins; crosscheck is a verdict input

provenance.note: every filled cell carries the winning source, its delay and when it was observed

nodes.label: SEC EDGAR (XBRL filings)
nodes.notes: 10-K/10-Q/8-K XBRL; the only source allowed to be canonical for statements

nodes.label: Nasdaq (exchange site)
nodes.notes: session calendar and delayed last sale; official for market_state, not for price

nodes.label: European Central Bank reference rates
nodes.notes: daily EUR reference rates; the only FX cross-rate source in the graph

nodes.label: iShares fund pages (holdings)
nodes.notes: ETF holdings file is the index-membership oracle

nodes.label: Company investor-relations site
nodes.notes: press releases and dividend notices; event-driven, never a price

nodes.label: OpenFIGI mapping API
nodes.notes: FIGI/ISIN mapping at share-class level

nodes.label: Finnhub
nodes.notes: last trade with a token; a second vendor for fundamentals

nodes.label: Polygon.io
nodes.notes: options chain with greeks; SIP quotes on the paid tier

nodes.label: Yahoo Finance
nodes.notes: crumb/cookie warm-up; beta is the 5-year monthly figure and its window must travel with it

nodes.label: Stooq
nodes.notes: free daily bars; the second bar source a technical can be recomputed from

nodes.label: CoinGecko
nodes.notes: crypto only; 24/7 session, no MIC

nodes.label: Google Finance
nodes.notes: per-symbol page, no bulk; a last-resort fallback for a symbol

nodes.label: Barchart
nodes.notes: consensus estimates are opinion, not fact; only used as a cross-check for forward figures

nodes.label: TradingView scanner
nodes.notes: scanner endpoint is 15m delayed; no export; computes beta_1_year only

nodes.label: Finviz
nodes.notes: robots.txt forbids the screener; its high52w/low52w column is percent distance, market_cap is USD millions

nodes.label: Interactive Brokers gateway
nodes.notes: no gateway in this deployment; never a primary until one exists

nodes.label: GDELT
nodes.notes: 5-second pacing; a news signal, never a price

nodes.label: Google News RSS
nodes.notes: headlines by query; the article is the source, the RSS is only the index

nodes.label: Entity resolution (internal)
nodes.methodology: identity-v1: (mic, symbol) from reference/venue_master.json joined to FIGI/ISIN; a provider-internal id is never exported
nodes.notes: the only node allowed to mint instrument_id

nodes.label: Technical indicators (internal)
nodes.methodology: technicals-v1: SMA/EMA, Wilder RSI-14 and ATR-14, 20-day volatility and average volume from adjusted daily bars
nodes.notes: computed, not scraped: a platform's Buy label is an opinion

nodes.label: Return and size buckets (internal)
nodes.methodology: performance-v1: close-to-close returns over 1d/1w/1m/3m/6m/ytd/1y/3y/5y from adjusted closes; size_bucket from USD market cap
nodes.notes: window arithmetic on stored bars, never a vendor's precomputed return

nodes.label: Quality ledger (internal)
nodes.methodology: quality-v1: filled/verified column counts, the data_quality enum of app.contracts and the achieved freshness, from the verification ledger
nodes.notes: the six verify columns; no provider access at all
